title: No definite protocol-independent I_max identified (part b)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body: Part (b) asks for THE maximum entropy reduction $I_{max}$ over ANY feedback protocol. The solution returns $I_{max}=N\log2$ with $N$ a free design parameter, and concedes $I_A$ is unbounded in the continuous zero-dwell idealisation. Hence no single supremum over all protocols is identified; the stated $I_{max}$ is protocol-class dependent. A complete answer must produce a genuinely protocol-independent invariant (or rigorously justify the per-decision / per-unit-time normalization as the true supremum).
